risk_summary: The disclosure signals severe governance, reporting, regulatory, and credit-quality risk, including material misstatements spanning 2006 through 2012, restatements, SEC and SIGTARP inquiries, and enforcement actions. Elevated nonperforming loans and foreclosed properties, concentration reductions, dividend restrictions, and mandated capital ratios indicate substantial financial and supervisory pressure. Although 2013 was profitable, earnings benefited materially from a $27.2 million reduction in loan-loss provision and should be viewed cautiously.
